$comment: Per-install values baked into the Studio build as unique placeholders and substituted at start by runtime/supavise-runtime-config.mjs. build.sh exports each placeholder as the build-time value of `env`, and fails if one does not survive into the build output. `kind`: url (http or https URL, trailing slash dropped), url-platform (same, and a missing /platform suffix is added), string, csp-hosts (list of host sources for the CSP). `origin` is the placeholder origin that appears alone in the CSP; it is replaced by the origin of the real URL.

values.doc: Management API as the browser reaches it, for example https://api.example.com/platform.
Dashboard GoTrue (supavise-gotrue@system) as the browser reaches it, including its path, for example https://api.example.com/auth/v1.
Public URL of the dashboard itself, for example https://studio.example.com. Used for redirect URLs.
hCaptcha site key. Empty (the default) renders no captcha widget (patch 0001).
Comma-separated feature keys to disable before login (patch 0002).
Host sources that serve project APIs, for example *.api.example.com (patch 0003). Each is allowed over https and wss.
